rationale: Operator ruling 2026-11-01 via decision rubric (planner session). Problem: the gate refuses a task that names its own not-yet-created deliverable, while the review-scope baseline and the bug-task hook require that same path, so authors strip detail to pass. Evidence: about 4 real catches (wrong path AISDLC-183, deleted file AISDLC-1122, removed fixtures) against about 12 gate-maintenance commits and 4 false-positive repairs; 2 of 22 red gate runs in the prior 24h, both false positives; no consumer of references needs existence. Counter-argument: four catches a reviewer would spot anyway, delete it. Rebuttal: the catches were deletes reviewers missed, and the AISDLC-1146 pre-push rename guard depends on the tool; the pain is one pattern plus dead wiring, which the narrow option removes. Selected over delete because residual value is real; over filing-only because a later rename is never seen. Class (a): reversible, no control loosened beyond warnings.
